breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible perforated strip is switched to a displacement-only formulation on the claim that the hole removes locking
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt by stating, 'Use a displacement-only finite element formulation... since volumetric locking is mitigated by the hole.' The ground truth corrects this, specifying that a 'mixed displacement-pressure formulation' is necessary because the material is nearly incompressible (ν is close to 0.5).
